description: Mechanical backstop for a subset of the TypeScript Patterns Enforcer rules; engine/README.md lists them. Runs after every .ts/.tsx edit, and again at Stop over TypeScript files changed this session, including files written through a shell that the edit hook never sees (advisory). Self-contained — never reads or writes the target repo's own ESLint/tsconfig. Degrades silently to prose-only enforcement if Node isn't available.
